title: ws-voice-room (server to app)

scope.description: run: the joined participants of the run; session: the owner and the viewers of the Session.

members.description: In join order; empty when the room is closed or the receiver was removed.

mic.description: on: open microphone; off: muted by the person; ptt: push-to-talk (sends only while the key is held).

muted_by_host.description: Set by the Session owner with voice_mute; always false in a run.

description: The full voice room, sent to every device in it on every change (join, leave, mic change, host mute, a member leaving the run or Session) and to the device that just left or was removed. When the run or Session ends the room is closed: devices get one last voice_room with no members. Needs together_v1.
